title: Protein Strawberry Ice Cream Bites | High-Protein Treat #easyrecipe
description:
These protein strawberry ice cream bites are creamy, chocolate-coated, and bursting with fresh strawberry flavor in every bite. Made with simple ingredients, they freeze into the perfect combination of a smooth strawberry filling and a crisp chocolate shell.

The cottage cheese blends into a rich, creamy base while fresh strawberries add natural sweetness and vibrant fruit flavor. A layer of melted chocolate on the bottom and top creates a satisfying chocolate shell that cracks with every bite.

This easy no-bake recipe is perfect for healthy desserts, summer treats, meal prep snacks, or whenever you want a refreshing frozen dessert without complicated steps.

Ingredients
1 cup cottage cheese
1 cup strawberries
2 tablespoons sugar-free sweetener (optional)
1/2 cup sugar-free chocolate chips, melted

Instructions
Blend the cottage cheese, strawberries, and sweetener until completely smooth.
Pour a thin layer of melted chocolate into a lined muffin tin.
Freeze for a few minutes.
Add the strawberry mixture.
Top with the remaining melted chocolate.
Freeze until firm.
Enjoy.

Quick Tip
Freeze the chocolate base before adding the filling for clean, distinct layers and the perfect chocolate shell.

These strawberry ice cream bites are creamy, refreshing, and loaded with fresh strawberry flavor in every bite.

Simple ingredients, fresh strawberry flavor, and a texture that turns crisp outside and creamy inside every time.
